svg.title: From circulation anatomy to six storage regions
svg.desc: Original functional diagram: left ventricle, systemic arteries, systemic veins, right ventricle, pulmonary arteries and pulmonary veins form a closed loop. Four valve links and two vascular resistance beds are labeled.
